en: Your application status could not be confirmed. Check again before submitting an application.
zh-Hans: 暂时无法确认申请状态，请重新查询后再申请。

en: Application or identity status has changed. Check the current status before continuing.
zh-Hans: 申请或实名登记状态已变化，请查询最新状态后继续。

en: The current service requires publisher identity registration. A US identity-registration path is not yet confirmed. Choosing merchant entry does not grant merchant access.
zh-Hans: 当前服务要求发布者实名登记，美国实名登记路径尚未确认。选择商家入口不会获得商家权限。

en: Upload a business license before continuing
Select a clear business-license image. Photos stay on your device until you confirm upload. The selected image is converted to JPEG with location metadata removed; the local limit is 10 MB.
zh-Hans: 请选择清晰的营业执照图片。确认上传前，照片仅保留在本机。所选图片会转换为 JPEG 并去除位置元数据，本机大小限制为 10 MB。

en: Business license received by the service
This photo could not be prepared. Choose a supported image smaller than 10 MB.
zh-Hans: 无法处理这张照片，请选择小于 10 MB 的受支持图片。

en: The upload could not be confirmed. It may have reached the service, but no usable receipt was received. Your previous license, if any, is unchanged. Choose and confirm a new upload only if needed.
zh-Hans: 无法确认上传结果。图片可能已到达服务，但未收到有效回执；如有原执照，原执照保持不变。如确有需要，请重新选择并确认上传。

en: Send the selected business-license image to the configured Chengyin service for merchant application review. The document may include personal information. Uploading alone does not submit your application.
zh-Hans: 将所选营业执照图片发送给已配置的城瘾服务，用于商家入驻审核。证件可能含有个人信息。单独上传图片不会提交入驻申请。
提交这份商家入驻申请？

en: Send the reviewed store details, contact phone, address, business hours and uploaded license reference to the configured Chengyin service for review. Submission does not grant approval or merchant access.
zh-Hans: 将已核对的门店资料、联系电话、地址、营业时间和已上传执照信息发送给已配置的城瘾服务审核。提交不代表审核通过，也不会获得商家权限。

en: Identity registration is required before license upload or application submission.
zh-Hans: 上传执照或提交申请前，需要完成实名登记。

en: The current source service requires a mainland Chinese resident ID with an 18-character checksum. A supported US registration process has not been verified, so this app cannot complete new identity enrollment. No SSN or EIN is requested here.
zh-Hans: 当前源服务要求具有校验位的 18 位中国大陆居民身份证号。美国登记流程尚未核实，因此本应用暂不能完成新的实名登记。此处不会要求 SSN 或 EIN。

en: Registration status is unconfirmed. No upload or application can be sent yet.
zh-Hans: 尚未确认实名登记状态，暂不能上传或提交申请。

en: Submission was acknowledged. The status below comes from the server; approval and merchant access are separate decisions. This application will not be sent again automatically.
zh-Hans: 服务已确认收到提交。下方状态来自服务器；审核通过与商家权限分别确认。本申请不会自动再次提交。

en: Submission outcome is unknown. Check the server status before taking further action. A missing or unchanged application does not prove the submission failed, so resubmission is blocked in this session.
zh-Hans: 提交结果尚不明确。请先查询服务器状态。未查到申请或状态未变化并不能证明提交失败，因此当前会话禁止重复提交。

en: The server currently reports no application. This readback alone does not resolve the earlier submission outcome.
zh-Hans: 服务器当前报告无申请，仅此查询结果尚不能确定先前的提交结果。

en: The application was not sent. Review the current application and identity status.
zh-Hans: 申请尚未发送，请核对当前申请与实名登记状态。
服务器返回的申请状态

en: Merchant operating permissions are checked separately against the current account on the server.
zh-Hans: 商家经营权限会根据当前账号单独向服务器查询。

en: Merchant operations are unavailable while the account is disabled. A platform review is needed. If no reason is shown, the service has not supplied one.
zh-Hans: 账号停用期间无法使用商家经营功能，需要等待平台复核。未显示原因时，表示服务未提供停用原因。

en: The application is approved and the account is enabled. Merchant permissions still come from the current server access check.
zh-Hans: 申请已通过且账号已启用。商家权限仍以当前服务器权限查询为准。

en: Review the service’s reason, if supplied, and update your information before reapplying.
zh-Hans: 请核对服务提供的驳回原因，并完善资料后重新申请。

en: The application passed review, but account activation or other identity conditions are not yet complete.
zh-Hans: 申请资料已通过审核，但账号启用或其他身份条件尚未完成。

en: Your application is being reviewed. Use the status check for updates.
zh-Hans: 申请正在审核中，请查询状态获取最新进展。

en: Offline example: please provide a clearer license image
zh-Hans: 离线示例：请提供更清晰的执照图片

en: Offline example: account paused by the platform
zh-Hans: 离线示例：平台已暂停此账号

en: Upload or discard the selected photo before continuing
zh-Hans: 请先上传或移除所选照片，再继续
